matching.toleranceRule: target and measured must have the same nonzero sign; abs(target) >= minimumAbsoluteTarget; absolute error <= max(maximumAbsoluteDeltaError, maximumRelativeDeltaError * abs(target))
matching.acceptanceRule: Freeze one signed parameter per scene class and direction from that class's tuning variant; report achieved signed mean delta Y on its acceptance variant without refitting. This experimental effect normalization is not a universal slider mapping.

primary.contrastFormula: For each known line pixel, log2(line Y / nearby same-half background Y), comparing the first background neighbor at offsets [-2,-1,1,2] in that order. Mean the relative error within each half; then equal-weight the two half means.
primary.aggregation: Equal-weight mean over bright-line/dark-background and dark-line/bright-background regions and the four matched moderate (+/-20) directions. Report each region/direction separately. +/-40 are stress diagnostics with a critical veto only when matched. No noise-energy or clipping credit.
primary.roi: Input-defined bright line Y>0.8 on dark background Y<0.1 in upper half; dark line Y<0.1 on bright background Y>0.8 in lower half. Exclude outer 2 pixels and rows within 2 pixels of the half boundary. Empty half is missing evidence.

halo.reference: Same-side output plateau far from the edge, correcting any input-to-plateau residual; measure both positive and negative residual in fixed edge strips.
halo.limitRationale: 0.02 is the existing LC01 hard-edge critical limit, applied to tone-normalized edge residuals rather than intended global tone changes.

criticalComparison: Hue, gamut, clipping and alpha compare against the PicEdit result at the matched effect, with LC01 evidence/finite-value checks. Global LC01 RGB, gradient and local-envelope metrics remain diagnostics, not standalone tone-quality gates.

stages.primary: Developed input -> existing Denoise -> existing AutoTone -> LC03 tone with Exposure exactly once -> existing remaining tone/color -> existing Presence
stages.diagnosticAlternative: LC03 before existing AutoTone; separate diagnostic only, never pooled into primary acceptance

decisionOrder: A verified critical regression, an attributable budget violation, or a completed matched comparison without the required primary gain is no-go for this candidate.
Otherwise absent matching, required scenes, visual approval, accelerated-path parity, performance or integration evidence is blocked, never go.
Go requires the primary gain, all critical cases, matching, complete required evidence and visual approval; production integration additionally requires LC02.
requiredMissingUntilMeasured: Licensed real portraits, backlit natural edges, landscape texture and high-ISO photographs
Production cache, rapid slider/image changes, cancellation and preview/export integration
Accelerated path parity if an accelerated path is proposed
